record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, shorten the observed-history window from 128 to 64 positions, retaining the most recent interactions and existing positional representation. Most histories are short, so this may remove distracting older context and reduce padding computation while retaining substantial context for longer histories. Preserve masked-target training, appended-mask inference and final-position readout. Keep features, embedding design, backbone topology, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; propagate maxlen consistently through metadata and predictor generation.

category_rationales.rationale: Shorten the sequence window from 128 to 64 positions across all four datasets to test whether recent context improves validation HR@10. Keep masked-target training, appended-mask inference, positional representation and final-position readout unchanged. Existing metadata propagates MAXLEN to checkpoint construction and prediction.
